findings.recommendation: Route this signal to avoid ground plane gaps, or fill the void. If a split is intentional, add a bridge capacitor across the gap.

findings.title: No EMC filtering near J1
findings.description: Connector J1 (Barrel_Jack_MountingPin) has no ferrite bead, CM choke, or ESD protection within 25mm. Unfiltered I/O cables are the dominant source of radiated emissions — common-mode current as low as 5 µA can exceed FCC Class B.
findings.recommendation: Add a ferrite bead (e.g., BLM18AG601SN1D, 600Ω@100MHz) on signal lines near J1. Add ESD/TVS protection for external interfaces.

findings.title: Via stitching may be insufficient
findings.description: Board has 0 vias across 3172 mm² (no vias detected). For the highest frequency on this board (150 MHz), λ/20 stitching requires ≤48mm spacing.
findings.recommendation: Add ground stitching vias at ≤48mm intervals, especially at board edges and near connectors.

findings.title: Board cavity resonance frequencies
findings.description: Board (61×52mm, εr=4.4) cavity resonances: (1,0) at 1172 MHz; (0,1) at 1374 MHz; (1,1) at 1806 MHz; (2,0) at 2343 MHz; (2,1) at 2716 MHz. PDN impedance spikes at these frequencies. Ensure adequate decoupling at and around these frequencies.
findings.recommendation: Add decoupling capacitors with SRF near these frequencies.

coverage_matrix.note: Design rule checks identify common radiation sources. Cannot predict absolute emission levels.
Switching harmonic analysis and decoupling checks. EMI filter verification not yet implemented.
